sloka: ततो महात्मा स धनुर्धनुष्मानादाय रामः सहसा जगाम ।तं लक्ष्मणः प्राञ्जलिरभ्युपेत्य उवाच वाक्यं परमार्थयुक्तम् ।। ६.५९.४६ ।।।।
transliteration: tato mahātmā sa dhanurdhanuṣmānādāya rāmaḥ sahasā jagāma ।taṁ lakṣmaṇaḥ prāñjalirabhyupetya uvāca vākyaṁ paramārthayuktam ।। 6.59.46 ।।।।

translations.english: The great soul Rama who was holding a bow went seizing it. Lakshmana approached him immediately with folded hands and addressed Rama with words consonant with truth.
